policy.description: Blocking line-coverage ratchets. Update measured counts in the same reviewed change whenever scope or coverage advances; never lower a floor without an explicit, justified scope change.

tolerance.rationale: The #369 body-observer ownership fix adds one instrumented and covered client/core line so stale handles compare their exact subscriber identity before cleanup, advancing the reviewed high-water from 2326/2666 (87.247%) to 2327/2667 (87.252%). Two clean Node 22.20/V8 runs on 2026-07-27 each passed all 1788 tests across 233 files and reproduced exactly 2327/2667. Retaining the existing one-line tolerance makes the minimum 2326/2667 (87.214%), stricter than the prior 2325/2666 tolerated floor (87.209%). coverage-baseline.test.js retains the exact below-floor, above-baseline, scope-change, and broad-tolerance negative boundaries.

The #453 injected-shell HTTP fix preserves Jellyfin compression, adds strong transformed ETags with correct GET/HEAD and If-Match/If-None-Match behavior, internally revalidates source validators without exposing an unsafe source Last-Modified, and bounds/canonicalizes/coalesces cold fills. Behavioral coverage includes real response-compression ordering, identity/gzip/Brotli bodies, transformed 304/412 responses, source revalidation, two-client script-generation invalidation, cancellation-safe cache admission, encoded/decoded 2 MiB fallbacks, equivalent encoding keys, and concurrent cold requests. Seven clean .NET 10.0.9/Coverlet runs on 2026-07-27 each passed all 2,294 tests: two reproduced the observed high-water exactly at 27,316/36,060 instrumented lines (75.752%) and the other five measured 27,315/36,060. Recording the repeated high-water prevents either clean result from tripping the stale-baseline gate. Retaining the existing evidence-bounded five-line Coverlet tolerance makes the minimum 27,311/36,060 (75.738%), stricter than the prior 27,183/35,896 floor (75.727%). coverage-baseline.test.js retains the exact scope-drift, regression, stale-baseline, and broad-tolerance negative boundaries.
